proposed_supersession: The integrated two-formulation environment mapping and 18-test family. This acquisition contract does not activate ecological fitting or overwrite historical receipts. Selection and integration require a separate verified result.
hypothesis_boundary: Process blocks overlap physically and are not independent causes. These are literature-motivated association hypotheses, not established Cirsium mechanisms. Module-by-process tests are two-sided; only narrowly justified directions may be discussed as candidate interpretations. A protected representative preserves the question, not its statistical significance.

wetting_moisture.question: Does orientation or visible geometry covary with precipitation/moisture after conditioning on the other retained exposures?
wetting_moisture.basis: Wetting can reduce pollen longevity; floral structures and orientation can alter rain entry and pollen protection. Moisture also affects plant water supply, so precipitation does not isolate a rain-protection pathway.
wetting_moisture.limit: Monthly precipitation is not rain duration, intensity, actual capitulum wetness or verified rain avoidance. Image-relative orientation cannot directly establish gravitational inclination or adaptation.

radiation.question: Does the colour module, and potentially orientation, covary with shortwave radiation?
radiation.basis: Light enhanced anthocyanin synthesis in intact Petunia corollas; sunflower head-orientation experiments link orientation to temperature, flowering physiology and reproductive performance.
radiation.limit: These findings motivate, but do not demonstrate, the mechanism in Cirsium. Broadband shortwave is not UV exposure or head-absorbed radiation. JPEG CIELAB chroma is not anthocyanin concentration; no universal chroma coefficient sign follows.

heat_drying.question: Does visible geometry or colour covary with atmospheric water demand and thermal exposure?
heat_drying.basis: VPD treatments in cut roses changed transpiration and hydration; carnation temperature treatments changed anthocyanin content and flower development. Floral energy-balance modelling connects geometry, radiation, convection and transpiration.
heat_drying.limit: Evidence for water balance and temperature is stronger than a signed prediction for these dimensionless image endpoints. Cut-flower responses do not establish wild Cirsium adaptation. VPD is not soil drought or a replacement for temperature.

mechanical.question: Does orientation or geometry covary with wind exposure, without assuming a universal coefficient direction?
mechanical.basis: Daffodil flowers reoriented in wind and reduced drag; bumblebee landing experiments show that wind can alter flower approach independently of orientation.
mechanical.limit: Transfer to thistle heads is indirect. Mean gridded wind does not measure gusts, local head motion, stem stiffness or drag; dimensionless outline metrics do not measure absolute frontal area. Wind also affects heat and water exchange, so the block is not mechanically exclusive.

context_only.BIO4: Temperature seasonality has no separate primary hypothesis in this process design.
context_only.BIO15: Precipitation seasonality has no separate primary hypothesis in this process design.
context_only.NPP: Distal productivity context, not a direct physical head exposure.

selection.protection_reason: One direct month-aligned representation per stated process, selected by biological proximity, not trait associations; protected variables are still diagnosed and can block readiness.
selection.algorithm: On a single fixed complete-case cohort for the 12 process candidates, iteratively remove the unprotected variable with the largest VIF >= 10. Lexicographic variable ID breaks exact ties. Recompute VIF after each removal. If protected variables still have VIF >= 10, stop without a selected model. This is an explicitly weighted keep-style VIF procedure, not an invocation of usdm or its default random 5000-row sample.
selection.weights: Each taxon represented in the fixed complete-case selection cohort has total weight one; no random subsampling. All source observations remain in the saved matrix, including missing environment values.
selection.missingness: No imputation or fallback exposure. Report variable coverage and source-to-complete-case attrition, including taxa lost. Missing required process support or a constant eligible variable blocks automatic selection.
selection.threshold_meaning: A redundancy screen, not proof of stable independent effects or control of confounding.
selection.excluded_information: Retain all 15 numerical columns. An excluded variable's unique variation was not separately tested; retained proxies do not recover it without loss.

model.family: 3 modules x 4 process blocks x 3 scale questions; Holm across all 36 slots, with non-estimable slots retained and no fabricated P values.
model.test: Joint coefficients of one retained process block across the module response coordinates, conditional on every other retained block and nuisance terms; not separate single-process regressions and not sequential order-dependent sums of squares.
model.scale: Use the same saved source-taxon-balanced predictor centers and SDs across modules and within/among scales; diagnose actual complete model support without reselecting variables using outcomes.
model.time_windows: Observation-month 1981-2010 climatology plus any retained annual/seasonal context within its process block. Distinguish these time windows when interpreting coefficients; none is actual photography-day weather.
model.interactions: Not included in the primary additive model. Any bounded interaction extension requires a separate pre-outcome rule and within/among estimand.
model.remaining: Model-cohort calendar/imaging/spatial identification, joint covariance-aware hierarchy and dependence-aware null/coverage calibration remain necessary before fitting.

execution.scope: Local full-native environment extraction and outcome-blind selection only
execution.source_identity: Save strong object ETag, content length and last-modified before and after raster sampling, plus numerical checkpoint SHA-256. Range-sampled source object identity is not a locally verified SHA-256 of the entire remote raster.
execution.provider_failure: Preserve completed checkpoints and report incomplete acquisition; never encode a network failure as environmental missingness or a biological negative.
